literal: Enemies destroying and loved ones prospering and, if one considers, through penance will come.
translation: If one considers, both the power to destroy one's enemies and the power to elevate one's friends are attained through the strength of penance.
modern: ஆராய்ந்து பார்த்தால், பகைவர்களை அழிப்பதும் அன்பானவர்களை உயர்த்துவதும் தவ வலிமையால் மட்டுமே கைக்கூடும்.
explanation: The couplet highlights the immense, dual power of penance (தவம்). It states that if one deeply reflects (எண்ணின்), both the ability to punish or destroy adversaries (ஒன்னார்த் தெறலும்) and the ability to bless or elevate loved ones (உவந்தாரை ஆக்கலும்) are acquired through the power of penance (தவத்தான் வரும்). The word 'தெறல்' means to destroy or burn, indicating the destructive power of a sage's wrath, while 'ஆக்கல்' means to create or prosper, indicating their power to bless. Thus, penance is not merely passive endurance but a source of supreme spiritual power that can affect the external world in both destructive and constructive ways.
